title: While everyone watched Nvidia, this chip company passed a trillion

beats.narration: While everyone watched Nvidia, another chip company quietly crossed a trillion dollars.
Broadcom makes the custom chips and networking gear that tie AI data centers together.
When a tech giant wants its own AI chip instead of Nvidia's, it often calls Broadcom.
Its AI revenue has been roughly doubling year over year.
Add a software arm from its VMware deal, and you get steady cash on top of the AI boom.
Not every AI winner carries Nvidia's name. Follow for more.
